criteria.reason: Attempts Rumantsch Grischun but contains Italian words ('Oggetto', 'Tuo') and garbled forms ('desiredada', 'viavm', 'Cuortas').
Date (14 December), time (17.00–19.00), purpose (concert) and hall booking request are all clearly present.
Formal structure with honorific address, subject line, polite conditional and signature block suits a municipal authority.

summary: The response fulfils the request with a formal Romansh booking letter containing all key details, though the Rumantsch Grischun shows Italian interference and garbled words.
